name: dsh-dba-plugins
description: Demo DSH plugins: one MySQL DBA capability (scripts/mysql_query.sh) packaged three ways — Skill, MCP server, and a directly-registered Tool — as three independent installable packages.

scripts.pack:skill: mkdir -p dist && pnpm --filter dsh-dba-skill exec npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist
scripts.pack:mcp: mkdir -p dist && pnpm --filter dsh-dba-mcp exec npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist
scripts.pack:tool: mkdir -p dist && pnpm --filter dsh-dba-tool exec npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist
scripts.pack:all: npm run build && npm run pack:skill && npm run pack:mcp && npm run pack:tool
